LightningComponentBundle.description: Service / Marketing - Configurable list of notification subscribers with auto-generated colored avatars, channel badges (Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Push), relative subscription age and notification counter. Mock data mode - no Apex, no SOQL. Bilingual EN / FR.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title, empty state, footer text and subscription label.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language dictionary default.

property.name: contactNames
property.label: Names (pipe-separated)
property.default: Lisa Andre|Quentin Lefevre|Justine Mercier|Romain Dupont|Clara Lambert

property.name: channels
property.label: Channels per name (pipe-separated)
property.description: Accepted: Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Push. Aligned by index with names.

property.name: subscribedAtRelative
property.label: Subscription ages (pipe-separated)
property.default: 6 h ago|6 h ago|6 h ago|6 h ago|5 h ago
